newsitem.title: USA: Chiron in vaccine distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: Chiron in vaccine distribution deal.

text.p: Chiron Corp said it reached an agreement with General Injectables & Vaccines Inc and a group of affiliated companies to distribute its vaccine products in the United States.

Under terms of the agreement, General Injectables, and affiliated companies, InSource Inc and Resolve Medical Marketing, all based in Virginia, will provide warehousing, distribution, customer service, billing and related services for Chiron's vaccines business.

"As we near the introduction of our first vaccine products in the U.S. market, this agreement allows us to command a proven, full-scale, state-of-the-art distribution network at launch through a highly cost-effective approach," said Dr. Dino Dina, president of the Chiron vaccines business unit.

Chiron said it is preparing to launch a rabies vaccine in the United States and is readying its regulatory applications to market a combined diptheria/tetanus/genetically engineered vaccine in the United States and Europe. It said its adjuvanated flu vaccine has received final recommendation for approval in Italy.
Other vaccine candidates in its pipeline include ones for genital herpes, hepatitis C, HIV, and hepatitis B.
